title: Burst of chat.postMessage calls to one channel drops messages or returns ratelimited
symptoms: Some messages in a burst never appear in the channel
cause: Posting is limited to about one message per second per channel plus a workspace-wide cap. Slack tolerates short bursts but may not store or display messages past the limit.
fix: Queue outgoing messages per channel at one per second, honor Retry-After, and batch updates into one message where possible.
apply:
from slack_sdk.http_retry.builtin_handlers import RateLimitErrorRetryHandler
client.retry_handlers.append(RateLimitErrorRetryHandler(max_retry_count=3))  # resends after Retry-After
for msg in queue[channel]:
    client.chat_postMessage(channel=channel, text=msg)
    time.sleep(1)
affected: Slack Web API chat.postMessage and incoming webhooks, as of 2026-10
